posts.cooked:
I want to make sure I play this correctly.  Where is the dividing line for "increase the next damage dealt" for powers like Haka of Battle or Absolute Zero's incapacitated power.  Let's say Haka of Battle is played then Haka uses Taiaha.  Does it increase both attacks?

Now for AZ's incapacitated power.  When Fanatic deals 1 target - 1 melee damage and 1 radiant damage, are both increased by 2?  Then how about Ra with Inferno or Drawn to the Flame where multiple targets are affected, or Chain Lightning?  I'm looking to know where to draw the line between the next damage dealt and the damage after that which will not be affected.  Thanks in advance.

posts.cooked:
Something happened to me while playing the app version that I definitely would have misplayed in real life, so I figured I'd share it here.  It was a few weeks ago so I'm making up some details, but here's the gist:

I used Haka of Battle and discarded several cards.  Then I absentmindedly attacked Dawn whilst on her flipped side.  On Haka's next turn I attacked a citizen and whomped them for a ton of damage.  It makes sense in retrospect that since I had not dealt damage to Dawn, the damage to the Citizen on my next turn was my "next damage dealt".  I just never would've thought to play it that way in real life.

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: That’s because saying you are using a power isn’t a separate step. The only way to use a power is to actually use it and have it resolve. Only then, do triggers based on using a power activate.
posts.raw: That's because saying you are using a power isn't a separate step. The only way to use a power is to actually use it and have it resolve. Only then, do triggers based on using a power activate.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
arenson9:

And still seems like a bug. Why should you get to change the choice?

Because all bonuses are recalculated when redirection occurs.

You look at all the cards and see which ones are applicable for this new target and apply them again/for the first time, choice of plus or minus 1 and type of damage are parts of the bonus that TtE applies.
